title: Worldwide reputation compared with Louis Armstrong
summary: Purnell says he is well known worldwide but not like Satch, his best friend, whom he enjoys talking with.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I mean, I know Satch has done an awful lot over there, but I just wondered how you other fellows that are not, if you pardon me, I'm not belittling you, but you're not as known to the public in general as well as Satch is.

No, I don't think I am, but I'm very well-known all around the world. I've been playing all around Australia and Sweden, Switzerland, and all like that, and I'm very well-known around the world, but not as good as Satch.

Well, no, I wasn't belittling you, because I've known you for a good many years. I mean, I've known your technique and your ability and your records and so forth, and I've got a lot of them home, and I play them too. But I have to admit, and I think you will too, that as far as publicity goes, I think Satch has a little more than you have.
Oh, yes, Satch is the greatest, man. That's my best friend.

I haven't seen him in years. I had him on interviews some years ago when he had Tee Garden with him and Barrett Deems and a lot of the other boys were with him at the time. They were playing over in San Francisco, and we had him on the air, and he was a kick to talk to.
Oh, I could just talk to Louis, but I don't have to hear him play. Just talk with him, and I enjoy myself. He's a wonderful guy to talk with, man, you know.
